subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Analisar, criticamente, o conteúdo de textos, comparando diferentes perspectivas apresentadas sobre um mesmo assunto.

components.description_pt: Contrastar informações ou perspectivas diferentes apresentadas em dois textos sobre o mesmo tema
components.description_en: Contrast differing information or perspectives presented in two texts on the same topic
components.cc_component_description: Contrast differing information or perspectives presented in two texts on the same topic

components.description_pt: Comparar como diferentes autores interpretam os mesmos fatos sobre um tema compartilhado
components.description_en: Compare how different authors interpret the same facts about a shared topic
components.cc_component_description: Compare how different authors interpret the same facts about a shared topic

components.description_pt: Avaliar criticamente o conteúdo de um texto contrastando-o com um ponto de vista alternativo
components.description_en: Critically evaluate the content of a text by contrasting it with an alternative viewpoint
components.cc_component_description: Explain how an author's technique for contrasting viewpoints shapes the meaning of the text

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast the most important points presented by two texts on the same topic.
Analyze how two or more authors writing about the same topic shape their presentations of key information by emphasizing different evidence or advancing different interpretations of facts.
Analyze how an author develops and contrasts the points of view of different characters or narrators in a text.
